faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGT-History post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the PGT-History post at PMSHRI PGHSS Kholan is 19th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the PGT-History position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the PGT-History post, candidates must have completed their Post Graduation in History with a minimum of 50% marks. Additionally, a B.Ed or an equivalent degree recognized by NCTE is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the PGT-History recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the PGT-History position is 65 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this PGT-History recruitment at PMSHRI PGHSS Kholan.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the PGT-History post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the PGT-History post primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on the verification of their submitted documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the PGT-History post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the PGT-History post will be paid Rs. 400 per class, with a maximum of 50 classes per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the PGT-History post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the PGT-History post announced by PMSHRI Panchayat Govt. Higher Secondary School, Kholan.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: The application for the PGT-History recruitment must be submitted in offline mode. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post or as instructed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this PGT-History recruitment at PMSHRI PGHSS Kholan is 207.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the school located?
faq.answer: The PMSHRI Panchayat Govt. Higher Secondary School is located in Kholan, Odisha.
